intro.text: An Alethi lieutenant in the Kholinar Wall Guard, usually called Noro, who leads the squad Kaladin joins in the besieged city.

items.text: Noro took Kaladin, in uniform in besieged Kholinar, for a deserter, but welcomed him kindly and offered him a hot meal. Kaladin soon joined the Wall Guard and was placed in Noro's squad.

Noro led his men on wall duty and patrols and through Fused raids. Though mortified by Kaladin's blunt questioning of Highmarshal Azure, he saw Kaladin's skill, suggested he be promoted, and began deferring to him in battle.
Noro's squad acted as Kaladin's honour guard in the final assault on the palace. In the fighting he killed two singers Kaladin knew, and was then cut down by Khen's axe.

appearance.text: Light blue eyes and a wispy dark beard, usually in the Wall Guard's blue uniform.

personality.text: Charming in a merchant-like way, welcoming and protective of his men, he hushes talk of sensitive subjects. In battle he is competent but not very assertive.
